BUILDPLAN.md T-18 (M3).

Review surface (local, served by the CLI): one screen per candidate, accept/reject-with-reason/edit-and-reverify, difficulty judged, **affirm** as a blocking gate with who/when, middle-beat and quoted-output checks; §11.1 trope matches highlighted beside `explains`, `why_tempting` and `hint` as warnings that block nothing (`SPEC.md` §7.4, D-23)

Criteria: AC-19–22, AC-72–74, AC-88, AC-95, G-12
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14, T-15b
BUILDPLAN notes: —

Orchestrator notes: Reads `near_duplicate_of` written by T-17.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: AUDIT from the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md, audit tree 0c7d60a): GAP-24 (G-12, Major): there is no affirmation writer, and the gate trusts hand-typed strings (schedule.py:147; audit.py:1085-1087; bank.py:206). Adds scope, pending the F-57 ruling: bind the affirmation to the text it affirmed (explains, why_tempting, trace), and make review.status 'edited' clear it.

RULING F-52 (client, 2026-10-10: 'Organizer edit for q3'): q3 is affirmed now by the client's documented edit of its review block (status accepted, affirmed_by, affirmed_at) in a small PR, outside this ticket. The 'affirmed by use' fallback is withdrawn for q4, q7 and q8: they need traces and an affirmation through T-18 (this ticket); q8 also waits on F-15. When planning, do not rewrite or re-affirm q3's hand affirmation; treat it as an existing record the surface must display and keep.

data.body:
RULING (client, 2026-10-11: '1, narrow it into the TUI'). PQ-23 is narrowed, not cancelled. PR #64 (draft, codex/organizer-trace-preview, head 50cd985, prototypes/organizer-tui) already gives the organizer TUI: preview, the trace step navigator, explicit reveal, and scheduling through the Python scheduler. That replaces this ticket's preview screens and its 'local web surface served by the CLI' form. PR #64 says review decisions are not implemented and that preview and scheduling leave bank records unchanged, so this ticket keeps exactly that part.

NEW SCOPE, as screens in the organizer TUI: accept; reject with a reason; edit and re-verify (the verifier writes verified output, never the TUI, AC-7); difficulty judged; AFFIRM as a blocking gate that records who and when; middle-beat and quoted-output checks; SPEC 11.1 trope matches shown beside explains, why_tempting and hint as warnings that block nothing (D-23). Criteria unchanged: AC-19-22, AC-72-74, AC-88, AC-95, G-12. Carried: GAP-24 (bind the affirmation to the text it affirmed: explains, why_tempting, trace; an edit sets review.status 'edited' and clears it), the F-52 ruling (q3's hand affirmation is an existing record to display and keep, never rewritten; q4/q7/q8 get traces and an affirmation through this ticket; q8 also waits on F-15), and the near_duplicate_of display from T-17.

GATE: held until PR #64 merges; then base on origin/main and plan against the merged TUI's crate layout. Writes to bank records go through the pipeline's existing bank and verify code (no second writer in Rust unless the plan argues for it and the Orchestrator rules). If PR #64 does not merge, this ticket returns to the client before any dispatch.

The ruling's other terms stand: bank writes go through the pipeline's existing bank and verify code (no second writer in Rust unless the plan argues for it and the Orchestrator rules); GAP-24, F-52 and the T-17 near_duplicate_of display are carried.
